messages:
samir: Microprofile -> p99 spike on prod llm pool after yesterday's kernel-selector tweak. Observed on Llama2-13b (hidden=5120, heads=32). Anyone seeing KV eviction churn?
ellie: Yep. p99 jumped ~220ms -> ~640ms around the selector deploy. KV miss rate up ~15% on hot shards. :thinking:
maria: Which batch sizes / seq lengths? any repro steps?
samir: Quick log snippet from canary logs:```
[2026-01-28 15:12:03] request_id=ab12 kernel=matmul-fused-narrow seq=1024 batch=4 kv_evictions=12 p99=642ms
[2026-01-28 15:12:04] request_id=ab13 kernel=matmul-fused-narrow seq=64   batch=8 kv_evictions=0  p99=210ms
```
Repro command I used: `rdw microprofile --model llm-13b --seq-dist long_tail --runs 100 --collect=kvcounters,latency`
perf-bot: [ALERT] anomaly detected: llm-13b pool p99 > 500ms (window=5m). Ticket #INC-4821 created.
ellie: Hypothesis: rope_theta default drift + kernel selector now favors narrow-fused matmul for median seq, but long prefixes cause bigger KV footprint -> more evictions and thrash. Also batching heuristic favors packing short-turn chats; when a small fraction of long-turn sessions hit, selector misroutes kernels and we pay the penalty.
maria: Makes sense. Two quick mitigation options: 1) fallback selector policy -> seq-aware (prefer kernels based on prefix length and kv occupancy), 2) bump KV cache high-water mark for llm-13b pool (+20%) to reduce eviction churn.
samir: I flipped selector to legacy on one canary host; p99 dropped to ~240ms. So selector is the likely trigger. Need a controlled experiment across seq distributions before full rollout. Also note chat-template assumptions: many requests are short-turns but a minority long-turn users create heavy-tailed resource usage.
ellie: I'll generate synthetic workload with a 5% long-turn heavy tail and run the microprofile harness. Will produce flamegraphs + per-kernel time breakdown.
maria: Proposed selector config snippet to canary (I'll apply if folks ack):```yaml
selector_policy: seq-aware
seq_thresholds: [128, 512, 1024]
kvcache: 
  high_water_pct: 80  # increase from 60
  eviction_policy: lru
```
samir: Ack, please apply to canary 3 hosts for 30m and let perf-bot watch. Also add a microprofile hook to log the chosen kernel name per request (short term).
maria: Applying now -> `kubectl set env deployment/llm-13b-selector SELECTOR_POLICY=seq-aware --record` and `kubectl set env deployment/llm-13b-kvcache KVC_HIGH_WATER=80`
perf-bot: [UPDATE] canary changes deployed to 3 hosts. Monitoring p99 and kv_evictions.
perf-bot: [RESOLVED] window=10m: p99 reduced to 260ms on canary; kv_evictions down 70%. Will keep monitoring and roll out if stable. :thumbsup:
samir: Nice, thanks. Next steps: 1) add kernel-switch tracing to microprofile harness, 2) run A/B across seq distributions before global selector rollout, 3) add a regression alarm for KV eviction rate > 10% baseline.
ellie: I'll own the traces + flamegraphs. Dropping a bench link when done.
maria: I'll prepare a PR for selector defaults + kvcache sane defaults for Llama2/3 models (rope_theta notes included).
perf-bot: Noted for follow-ups: INC-4821 -> will attach traces.
